slides.title: Four uploads that ruin a shoot.
slides.body: If your results keep missing, look *here first*.

slides.title: The four culprits
items: Heavy filters — it learns the filter, not you
Sunglasses, masks, anything covering the face
Group photos — it can't tell which face is yours
Dark, blurry, or heavily compressed shots

slides.title: The filter one surprises people.
slides.body: A beauty filter changes your nose, your jaw, your skin. The model learns *that face*, then reproduces it faithfully.

slides.title: Give it this instead.
slides.body: Clear, well-lit, a few angles, one genuine smile.
